To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the interprofessional education activity using Facebook groups increased student knowledge about LGBTQ healthcare disparities, and that the discussion threads and reflection papers showed students recognized the importance of LGBTQ inclusive healthcare practices and the value of interprofessional education.
the use of a Facebook group as an educational platform for interprofessional students was feasible, but that the platform was not ideal.

(1) interprofessional students completed an asynchronous, online activity in a Facebook group to learn about LGBTQ healthcare and inclusive practice; (2) students' knowledge about LGBTQ health increased; (3) students valued interprofessional learning about LGBTQ healthcare and identified the need to incorporate inclusive practices into future professional practice; (4) students had mixed perspectives about the use of Facebook as an interprofessional education platform.
